title: Backup & Restore App
summary: Backup & Restore Apps with Split APK Support. Fast & Secure.
description:
📦 App Backup & Restore – Split APK Support

The powerful and easy-to-use App Backup & Restore tool for Android.
Backup, share, and restore your apps safely — including Split APK (.apks) support — with fast batch operations.

Perfect for managing storage, switching devices, or keeping offline backups.

🚀 Key Features

✔ Backup installed apps quickly
✔ Restore apps from backup files
✔ Split APK (.apks) support (New)
✔ Choose custom backup folder (Internal or External storage)
✔ Share backed-up apps easily
✔ Batch delete backup files
✔ Install apps directly from backups

⭐ Pro Features:
• Batch backup multiple apps
• Batch uninstall apps
• Faster multi-install

📂 Flexible Storage
Unlike other apps, you can select any folder location for backups:
• Internal storage
• SD card
• Custom folders

You are in full control of your backup files.

📺 Smart Ads Policy
We respect your experience.

• Watch one rewarded ad → Enjoy temporary ad-free usage
• Banner ads may still appear
• Upgrade to Pro for a fully ad-free experience

🛠 How to Use

Select apps to backup
Choose backup folder
Restore anytime from saved files

Enable "Install Unknown Apps" permission when restoring apps.

⚠ Important Notes
• If app shows "App Not Installed", uninstall previous version first
• Some banking/financial apps may not restore due to security restrictions
